description: Find parcels by address words, current owner name, or location (near a point or inside a small box), optionally limited to a county, city or ZIP. Returns pin, address, owner, county, location and a link to the parcel in the map app. Paginate with next_cursor.

address.description: Property address words, any order, e.g. '1313 gallatin'.

bbox.description: Bounding box 'west,south,east,north' in degrees (under about 5 km across).

county.description: County name, or several comma-separated, e.g. 'Davidson,Williamson'.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Results per page, 1–200 (default varies by tool).

owner.description: Current owner name words, e.g. 'bailey trust'. For former owners use search_owners.

q.description: Free text matched against the address, or the current owner name.

sort.description: relevance (default with text), distance (default with near), address.

name: search_properties
title: Search properties
